wdi_long = wdi_raw.melt(
    id_vars=["Country Name", "Country Code", "Series Name", "Series Code"],
    value_vars=year_cols,
    var_name="year",
    value_name="value"
)
wdi_long["year"] = wdi_long["year"].str.extract(r"(\d{4})").astype(int)

INDICATOR_MAP = {
    "life_expectancy":          "SP.DYN.LE00.IN",       
    "gdp_pc_current_usd":       "NY.GDP.PCAP.CD",       
    "internet_users_pct":       "IT.NET.USER.ZS",       
    "secondary_enrollment_pct": "SE.SEC.ENRR",          
    "female_labor_share_pct":   "SL.TLF.TOTL.FE.ZS",    
    "co2_tons_per_capita":      "EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5", 
    "health_exp_pc_usd":        "SH.XPD.CHEX.PC.CD"     
}

wdi_long = (
    wdi_long[wdi_long["Series Code"].isin(INDICATOR_MAP.values())]
      .drop(columns=["Series Name"])
)

numeric_cols = [
    "hdi",
    "gdp_pc_current_usd",
    "life_expectancy",
    "secondary_enrollment_pct",
    "internet_users_pct",
    "female_labor_share_pct",
    "co2_tons_per_capita",
    "health_exp_pc_usd"
]

for col in numeric_cols:
    merged[col] = pd.to_numeric(merged[col], errors="coerce")

model_data = merged.dropna(subset=numeric_cols)

In [174]:
predictors = [
    "gdp_pc_current_usd",
    "life_expectancy",
    "secondary_enrollment_pct",
    "internet_users_pct",
    "female_labor_share_pct",
    "co2_tons_per_capita",
    "health_exp_pc_usd"
]

num_vars = len(predictors)
cols = 3
rows = (num_vars // cols) + int(num_vars % cols > 0)

plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

for i, var in enumerate(predictors):
    plt.subplot(rows, cols, i + 1)
    sns.scatterplot(
        x=var,
        y="hdi",
        data=model_data,
        alpha=0.6
    )
    plt.title(f"HDI vs {var.replace('_', ' ').title()}")
    plt.xlabel(var.replace('_', ' ').title())
    plt.ylabel("HDI")

plt.suptitle("Scatterplots of HDI vs Predictors", fontsize=16, y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

In [182]:
years = sorted(model_data["year"].unique())
results_by_year = []

for yr in years:
    df_year = model_data[model_data["year"] == yr].dropna()
    X = sm.add_constant(df_year[[
        "log_gdp_pc",
        "life_expectancy",
        "secondary_enrollment_pct",
        "internet_users_pct",
        "female_labor_share_pct",
        "co2_tons_per_capita"]])
    y = df_year["hdi"]
    model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
    
    results_by_year.append({
        "year": yr,
        "R2": model.rsquared,
        "Adj_R2": model.rsquared_adj,
        "coef_log_gdp": model.params["log_gdp_pc"],
        "coef_life_exp": model.params["life_expectancy"],
        "coef_education": model.params["secondary_enrollment_pct"],
        "coef_fem_labor": model.params["female_labor_share_pct"],
        "coef_co2_tons": model.params["co2_tons_per_capita"]
    })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results_by_year)
results_df
